title: GIFT Habitat Explorer

chinook_juvenile_rearing.note: Late-summer rearing assessment. Juveniles also rear outside this season; adjust for the study objective.

chinook_spawning_stream_river.note: Upper Grande Ronde spring/summer Chinook spawning; does not represent fall Chinook timing.

chinook_spawning_large_river.note: Upper Grande Ronde spring/summer Chinook spawning; adjust for other stocks.

steelhead_juvenile_rearing.note: Late-summer rearing assessment. Steelhead juveniles rear across multiple seasons and years.

steelhead_spawning.note: Basin spawning window, March into June. Monthly means approximate partial-month endpoints.

salmonid_general_sensitivity.note: Late-summer sensitivity scenario, not a calibrated species or life-stage timing window.

aggregation: Median of separately evaluated monthly habitat results.
